reviews.text:
Very happy with Vito's Pool Service  for upgrading our salt system. From the initial consultation with Vito himself  to the installation by Alan, everyone was top-notch. Vito took his time to explain the best option for us,  clearly explained the best option, the process and the benefits. The installation was seamless. They left the pool pump area clean and even replaced a gauge for us, for free!! The price was great compared to other companies that didnt offer options at all.
The new system will improve our pool experience—now everything can be monitored from an app on our phones. We highly  recommend working with Vito and team.  Thank you for the outstanding service
reviews.author: ooo ooo

reviews.text:
Vito’s pool service was great to work with. Our booster pump for our Polaris cleaning robot broke over the weekend and I contacted Vito on Monday. He is very responsive and sent out his technician, Alan, on Tuesday with a replacement pump.
Alan did a great job installing the new booster pump and by Tuesday noon everything was working.
Price and labor was transparent and fair, easy to pay the invoice online as well.
Great service, highly recommend!
reviews.author: Peter Claes

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Vito. We had just bought a new house with a pool and I knew nothing about pools. The weather turned freezing and the pool pump wasn’t coming on automatically. I called Vito late at night. I wasn’t a customer, but he helped me anyway and gave me clear direction to get the pump kicked on. We were so relieved. Really Appreciate him taking the time to help us out and his ability to quickly identify the problem and tell us what to do.
reviews.author: dachiz

reviews.text: Vito's Pool Service is the best!  They provide weekly cleaning service of my pool and always do a excellent, very thorough job.  Recently, my pool filter failed.  I talked to Vito, and he had a replacement filter unit at my property and installed the same day.  The service technicians are always very professional.  Vito's pool service is always honest and fair.  I would eagerly recommend them to anyone needing regular pool service or emergency repairs.
reviews.author: Mark Schneider

reviews.text: I have had an ongoing valve issue since we owned this pool. It finally came to the point where it needed to be replaced. Due to the configuration, additional valves needed to be replaced. Vito came highly recommended by our neighbor. I contacted him, and he and his team responded immediately. They did a fantastic job replacing the valves with new plumbing. I would not hesitate to use him again
reviews.author: John Paschalis

reviews.text: What a difference the new pool equipment made! On 3/14/25, Vito and Alan upgraded my ancient, 27-year-old equipment with a new cartridge filter, efficient variable speed pump, and new plumbing. I was amazed at how quiet the new pump turned out to be! Vito and Alan completed the work in one day and were very good about communicating throughout the project and leaving my backyard in pristine shape. I will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Ellen Zokai

reviews.text: I highly recommend Vito’s Pool Service.  We had an issue with our filter pump not working and called on a Monday.   Vito and his team was able to provide great customer service that same day and get our equipment running again at a fair price.  If you have any pool equipment issues or need weekly service, look no further than Vito’s Pool Service.
reviews.author: Kris Karrigan

reviews.text: If you’re looking for honest people that know what they are doing, use Vito’s Pool Service!  I’ve used Vito’s Pool Service a few times now to replace my pool mastic and computer.  Both times the work was done on time and on budget.  The pool computer required total rewiring which took some extra work, but Alan was all over it!  System turned on like clockwork today and I couldn’t be happier.  Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Sal Berardesco

reviews.text: Vito is very responsive, fair and professional. He has always helped us out in a timely manner and professionally explains the issue(s) and the best course of action to take. Always honest and fair, in It’s great to find a company that is so exceptional at what they do.
reviews.author: Thomas Rosine

reviews.text: Vito's is the best.  They clean my pool weekly, and if I ever have any questions they are always there to answer.  Fair prices and quick service as well whenever you have an issue.  Give them a try!  You won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: Felicia Falso

reviews.text: Vito came to my house on an emergency call from 10 pm to 3 am. I'm pretty sure no one out there has that type of commitment and services. Best pool services ever. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: jonathan burgos

reviews.text: Our yard backs up to a creek & greenbelt so the ground around the pool moves & settles -A LOT! We have had several line breaks since our pool was installed in 2016.I contacted Vito's Pool Service to patch a leak on one of my pool's return lines out in my lawn (the ground was damp and soggy around the PVC break).  After taking care of it, Vito and crew ran pressure tests and found another, smaller leak on the opposite side of the pool under my patio. I do know from experience that other swimming pool repair companies would've patched the first leak and gone on their way. Kudos to Vito's Pool Service & crew for going the extra mile and doing the job right!
reviews.author: Bo Ayers

reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this company. From start to finish, they were honest, patient, and incredibly professional. They took the time to truly understand my situation and, rather that trying to profit from it, referred me to another trusted expert who specialized in exactly what I needed and was available right away. It's rare to find people in this industry who genuinely prioritize helping others over making a quick buck. I truly appreciate their integrity and willingness to be a trustworthy and solid resource. From now on, they'll be my only go-to pool professional. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Chris Knapp

reviews.text: Having been through multiple pool services for a variety of issues all the way from laziness to incompetence I can promise you that Vito’s is the single best pool company in the area. If you’re like me and you dig through reviews to try and get a gauge on companies, you can stop right here and just call Vito to sign up. Pricing is great, he doesn’t charge diagnostic fees to come look at issues, doesn’t gouge you when things need to be repaired, and they actually know how to take care of a pool.
reviews.author: Joe Mesler

reviews.text:
Vitos Pool Service has been taken care of our poole for several years now.  Super friendly service and they’re always on time and have our pool looking great for our kids! Even when we’ve had issues in the past with flooding, they were out the next few days to ensure that we would be able to enjoy the pool over the weekend. Definitely recommend!
A++++++
reviews.author: Aaron Morrow

reviews.text: If you want a one stop shop pool person, Vito and his team are it. They were able to convert my current setup into a more efficient and cost effective pool system and delivered on easy automation. Vito and his team are attentive, conscious of your needs and ensure you are aware of what is needed every step of the way. If you need cleaning service, repairs or even leak detection, look no further, Vito’s got your back!
reviews.author: Taylor Willis

reviews.text:
We are extremely happy with services from Vito and his staff for our pool needs. He has been our go to guy since last 4 years or more now. He is quick to identify root cause in the event of an incident. Upfront and honest about all options. Yes, he is Dr.Pool !
He helped us replace pool motor, booster pump and few repair work’s since we have known him. He has also honored pool motor warranties for us. In Summary, Strongly recommend him for your pool needs since he is
very knowledgeable, dependable, fair and a perfectionist.
reviews.author: G Mat

reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about Vito and Alan. Had a pump quit working on me and called Vito. I hoped for the best but was prepared for the worst. Alan and Vito exhausted all options before we were ready to replace it. They said let us try one more thing - a dang faulty display. Boom fixed. These guys saved me over $2k. They will forever be my go to guys for pool issues. I called multiple companies for a quote AND NEVER GOT A CALL BACK. Vito and I stayed in constant contact and he truly made my year! Give these guys a shot, you will not be disappointed. Thanks!
reviews.author: Patrick Kilpin

reviews.text: Reliable! Vito’s is by far the most reliable pool service we have found in DFW (Allen) and has made our pool in the best condition it’s ever been in. 10/10 would recommend!
reviews.author: Sarah Caras

reviews.text: Alan was amazing and such a blessing! Thank you so much for the transformation! My family can actually go swimming now before the summer is over! Alan was very nice and respectful! This company deserves 10 stars! Thank you so much again!
reviews.author: Raven Kemp

reviews.text: Vito Pool Service is always prompt, professional, and a pleasure to work with. They helped me with my pool cover installation, annual covering/uncovering, and any pool cleaning I need. They also helped me with a new skimmer installation. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tony Pope-Cruz

reviews.text: Vito’s pool service company is very professional and reliable pool service company. They replaced one of our pool lights that wasn’t working. From start to finish of process they were extremely professional and best part is their fast response. I will recommend them to anyone with pool issues or maintenance.
reviews.author: Jincy George

reviews.text:
I had a couple of fittings, (ones I had repaired after last years freeze) that had failed.  Needed to get these fixed quickly so I could turn the pump back on before an expected 2 days below freezing.  Contacted Vito on a Sunday, and he was able to come out that same day.  My pool had previously been a salt system pool, and I had removed the cell and bypassed when I made my repair. Vito came up with a solution to reduce the friction points and now my flow is better than ever.  Vito is friendly, professional and very knowledgeable.  Plus... the price was very  fair.  I highly recommend him.

UPDATE June 2024...
My 24 year old pump finally gave out.  I contacted Vito and he set me up with a great pump, a new pad and re-piped the system. All for a fair price.  This was done during the crazy rain storms in late May, so I really appreciate him working through the bad weather.  Wouldn't trust my pool to anyone else.  Thanks Vito.
reviews.author: Rick Baker

reviews.text: Vito’s did another great job removing the old mastic and replacing with the new. The deck looks great and is now protected from the elements!
reviews.author: Keith Dulaney

reviews.text:
Vito and his team are outstanding.  New to Texas, had no idea where to turn for pool service. Called Vito based on a recommendation on Nextdoor.

The first time I called for a filter/cartridge cleaning. They came out next day and did an outstanding job and was very reasonably priced.

When the cartridges needed to be changed, they came out promptly and again did a great job.

The cleaner on my filter failed and was spewing water everywhere. Called Vito, shared the part number and he told me he could file a warranty claim on my behalf. Short version, got it fixed for free. I would have gladly paid Vito to replace the cleaner.

First rate service, responsiveness, and priced very reasonably! If you are looking for help with your pool, look no further!
reviews.author: Jeremy Merlo

reviews.text: Had a filter issue and Vito’s showed up same day to help get it fixed. Highly recommend their services.
reviews.author: Kamron Chapman

reviews.text:
I have a non standard large spa / tiny pool that came from Canada.  It sprung a plumbing leak off one of my pumps. Several friends recommended pool/spa people but most said they couldn’t fix it.  One guy did tell me he could fix it but after 2 weeks and coming out twice he apologized and said he was not going to be able to finish the repair.
